answer: Allocate votes on harbor repairs, basalt mining and knoll restoration through fixed budgets. Five externally audited operators each receive eight uniquely numbered credits per epoch. Signed transfers debit the sender; validators require the current holder's signature and count each credit ID once per proposal. Approval needs 21 IDs. New aliases add no weight: an attacker must capture 21 existing credits through bribery, key theft or corrupted delegations. This assumes trustworthy bootstrap operators and prudent delegation.
